SourceProxy.label: SHYX Subset Coarsen
SourceProxy.name: SHYXSubsetCoarsen

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Subset Coarsen: Coarsen a triangle mesh without new vertices or moving survivors.

SourceProxy.Documentation:
Triangle-mesh coarsening that never inserts Steiner points and never relocates surviving vertices: CGAL edge_collapse onto an original endpoint. Cost Strategy is plane QEM (default; geometric error) or post-collapse minimum angle (element quality). Output vertices are a subset of the input vertices at the same coordinates.
Not SHYX Adaptive Isotropic Remesher (split / relaxation / projection) and not SHYX Edge Collapse (Lindstrom–Turk / QEM / midpoint placement move survivors). Input must be a pure triangle mesh; use Triangulate upstream for mixed cells. Stop predicate is the same Edge Count Ratio as SHYX Edge Collapse. Feature or boundary constraints, and the link condition, may stop before that ratio is reached.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: EdgeCountRatio
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Edge Count Ratio (stop)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Stop when (current undirected edges) / (initial undirected edges) is strictly below this value. Default 0.5. Constraints or the link condition may stop earlier at a higher ratio (a warning is issued).

IntVectorProperty.name: CostStrategy
IntVectorProperty.label: Cost Strategy
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: How the surviving original endpoint is ranked. Plane QEM: Garland–Heckbert plane quadrics at the two endpoints (geometric error). Min angle: keep the endpoint that leaves the larger minimum interior angle in the remaining star, and collapse better-quality moves first (cost = minus that angle). Placement is always an original vertex; neither strategy inserts points or relocates survivors.

IntVectorProperty.name: PreserveBoundary
IntVectorProperty.label: Preserve boundary
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON (default), every border edge is constrained and is not collapsed, so the boundary polyline stays. Mixed interior–border edges still collapse onto the remaining border vertex. Turn OFF to allow deleting border vertices (survivors are still a subset of the original vertices, unmoved).

IntVectorProperty.name: DetectFeatureEdges
IntVectorProperty.label: Detect feature edges
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON, CGAL detect_sharp_edges (Protection angle) marks sharp edges as constrained so they are not collapsed.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ProtectAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Protection angle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Dihedral angle in degrees for detect_sharp_edges. Adjacent faces whose normals differ by more than this angle mark the shared edge as a feature. Used only when Detect feature edges is ON.

IntVectorProperty.name: PreventNormalFlip
IntVectorProperty.label: Prevent normal flip
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: CGAL Bounded_normal_change_placement. When ON (default), refuse a collapse that would reverse a neighboring triangle's orientation.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseUpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, point/cell data are probed from the input onto the coarsened mesh.
